entities.summary: Count Berend Gregor Ferdinand von Tiesenhausen (Russian: Фёдор Ива́нович фон Тизенга́узен, romanized: Fyodor Ivanovich fon Tizengauzen; June 1, 1782 – December 2, 1805 was a Russian noble and military officer of German Baltic origin.
